notes: GPU/driver/power_limit are the verbatim output of `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,driver_version,power.limit --format=csv`. Warm-up call issued before timing so the model cold-load is not recorded. idle window ~12s; varied/loop ~20s each. This manifest was written by hand for run 2 (which predated the auto-manifest feature); later runs write their own.
